canonical_json.array_order: preserved unless field-specific set normalization says otherwise

identifier.comparison: exact UTF-8 byte equality after schema validation
identifier.alias_resolution: only explicit alias table entries before semantic execution; unknown alias is invalid_query

scope.assertion_compatibility: for each non-null query dimension, assertion dimension must equal it exactly; null query dimension matches any assertion value; rules may not invent scope values
scope.cross_scope_fusion: forbidden unless query dimension is null and all other proposition fields are identical

version_and_time.version_comparison: exact equality only; no lexical or semantic-version ordering is inferred
version_and_time.effective_from: inclusive UTC instant or null meaning unbounded past
version_and_time.effective_to: exclusive UTC instant or null meaning unbounded future
version_and_time.query_time: required when candidate assertions or rules have bounded effective intervals
version_and_time.effective: effective_from <= query_time and (effective_to is null or query_time < effective_to)
version_and_time.incompatible_version: assertion or rule excluded from derivation; a query naming an unknown version is invalid_query

proposition_normal_form.canonicalization: validate predicate and typed ordered arguments; normalize scalar values; normalize scope dimensions in fixed order; require exact version id; canonical JSON serialize fields_in_order

rules.rule_id: unique canonical identifier; duplicate ID invalid_source_packet
rules.ordering: unordered set semantics; evaluation order cannot affect closure
rules.semantically_duplicate_distinct_rule_ids: allowed; may create duplicate derivations but cannot change status
rules.range_restriction: every variable in head or negative/support condition must be bound by a positive typed premise
rules.fixpoint: least monotone closure over finite validated assertions/rules; terminate when no new normalized proposition+polarity pair is added

evidence.derivation_leaf_roots: sorted unique source assertion IDs reachable from a derivation proof
evidence.polarity_evidence_roots: sorted union of derivation_leaf_roots for every valid derivation of that polarity
evidence.completeness: all loaded valid derivations under the frozen finite rule set contribute to the union

proof_normal_form.node_id: sha256 of canonical JSON of the node fields excluding node_id; premise_node_ids are sorted lexicographically before hashing
proof_normal_form.graph: sorted node array by node_id plus sorted directed edges [premise_node_id,rule_node_id]
proof_normal_form.roots: sorted node IDs whose conclusions equal the queried proposition and requested polarity
proof_normal_form.ordering: node IDs and edge pairs lexicographic

outcomes.invalid_query: structural/schema/registry/type/arity/version error; no semantic status is produced
outcomes.needs_clarification: natural-question interpretation has unresolved mandatory field or multiple non-equivalent frozen query alternatives; no guessed query/status is produced
outcomes.runtime_error: implementation/infrastructure failure after a valid query; never mapped to unknown/refuted/supported/conflicting
outcomes.unknown: valid query with no positive and no negative derivation

acceptable_alternative_normal_form.equivalence: canonical JSON byte equality after field-specific normalization; no fuzzy/semantic equivalence at scoring time
acceptable_alternative_normal_form.multiple_alternatives: only alternatives frozen in query/outcome registries before first model output
